item.title: Adding Envoy Sidecars for Observability
item.description:
Adding Envoy Sidecars for Observability

How do you monitor a legacy app without changing its code? You use a sidecar proxy.

Over the weekend, I tested this on a K3s cluster. I used the Weaveworks Sock Shop as my legacy app. Here is how I added Envoy to get full HTTP metrics and distributed tracing.

The Problem: Zero Visibility

First, I deployed the base app. I added a load generator using an alpine image. It ran a constant curl loop.
